description: Two gamepads stacked vertically, the upper one flipped upside down facing the lower one across a gap, each a rounded body with splayed grips and dot buttons.
A front-facing bald oval head with two ears, short raised brows, dot eyes, a long straight nose and a wide open smiling mouth.
An ogre from the front: a squarish head with pointed ears jutting outward, heavy slanted brows, and a broad jaw set on a thick neck over a wide rectangular torso.
A circle with a wedge-shaped mouth cut from its right side, opening wide toward the right, with no eye mark.
A circle with a wide wedge-shaped mouth cut from its right side, and a small dot eye above the mouth.
A pinball ring at the top centre above two angled paddle flippers at the lower left and right, each a tapered rounded bar sloping down toward the middle.
A front-facing head under a wide round straw hat with a domed crown and brim band, messy hair at the sides, one open eye and one winking eye, a small scar and a smile.
A DualShock-style gamepad from the front: a wide body with two long rounded grips spreading down, and two round thumbsticks side by side low in the centre.
A tall upright PS5 console on the left with curved outer panels flaring at the top, beside a smaller DualSense controller with two thumbsticks resting at the lower right.
A tall PS5 console in side profile with its curved wing panel sweeping up, on a small foot, with a controller placed in front of it at the lower left.
An upright PS4 console on the left with an angled stepped top edge and a short cable hook, with a controller with two thumbsticks placed in front of it at the lower right.
An upright PS4 console seen from the front: a tall slab with a vertical inset panel down its left side, an angled step at the upper right corner, and a flat stand along the bottom.
A flat console in isometric view: a thin rectangular slab with a slanted front edge, a stepped layer along its lower-left side, and a small ring logo on the top surface.
Pikachu's head and upper body from the front: two long pointed ears with dark tips angled outward, oval eyes, a small W mouth, round cheeks and two short paws curling at the bottom.
A circle divided horizontally by a straight band through its middle, with a round button at the centre drawn as a ring holding a smaller ring.
